f2_issue_identity.title: Tautological active-import evidence anchors
f2_issue_identity.summary: The Stage-B wrapper sourced the expected filesystem digest and the trusted producer reference from the active-import evidence record itself and fed them back into validate_image_bound_active_import. A record proving its own truth by repeating a value is a tautology; the expected anchors must come from independent governed sources.

corrected_independent_image_anchor.independence: image id taken from the governed build_result AND independently confirmed via oci_inspection; the two must match (II-BUILD-INSPECT-IMAGE-ID-MISMATCH); no expected_image_id parameter exists; a tag/candidate-name/label is rejected (II-IMAGE-ID-IS-TAG-OR-LABEL / II-IMAGE-ID-NOT-DIGEST).

corrected_independent_filesystem_anchor.independence: manifest/config/filesystem/layer digests taken only from the dedicated OCI inspection producer; the signature has no active-import parameter and no caller expected_fs_digest parameter.

corrected_independent_producer_registry.independence: resolve() consults only the registry object, never an evidence record; a frozen registry cannot be mutated; self-registration, inline-from-evidence origin, wildcard scope, and checksum tamper are rejected; real_evidence_authority is registry-governed.

corrected_anchor_bundle.independence: parameters are typed anchor objects + registry + producer ids; passing the evidence Mapping as an anchor is rejected as AB-ANCHOR-WRONG-TYPE; provenance.derived_from_active_import must be False.

wrapper_integration.flow: build identity anchor + filesystem anchor from independent runner-supplied build_result + oci_inspection through a governed ProducerRegistry, assemble the independent bundle, then call ai.validate_active_import_against_bundle; on any reject return _reject('IMAGE-BOUND-IMPORT-FAILED:'+codes). The wrapper no longer copies fs_digest/producer_ref out of ai_evidence. When the runner supplies no independent artifacts the path is skipped and stays inert (behaviour identical to before).

future_stage_b_dependencies: A real, authorised Stage-B image must be built by a governed build producer that emits a real build_result (real image_id digest).
A dedicated OCI/image-inspection producer must emit real manifest/config/filesystem digests over the exported image filesystem.
A separate active-import-analysis producer must emit a real non-running import-graph + module inventory.
The three producers must be registered in the governed ProducerRegistry by an external approver with real_evidence_authority=True.
R2D2 must audit the exact real-image evidence before candidate readiness is asserted.
